description: This file defines a PHP controller class for handling employee contact details in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages pre-render processing, sets up front-end components with employee data, and enforces permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class extending BaseViewEmployeeController, responsible for managing employee contact details view, including setting up UI components and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by fetching employee number, initializing Vue component, adding properties, and setting permissions based on the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns a list of data groups necessary for permission capability checks, specifically related to contact details.
